newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: United Construction wins BHP iron contract.
newsitem.headline: United Construction wins BHP iron contract.

text.p: United Construction Group Ltd said on Tuesday it has secured a contract worth about A$23 million to construct conveyor systems at The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd Nelson Point iron ore facility in Western Australia.

United said the work involved structural, mechanical and electrical work associated with installing new conveyor systems and upgrading existing ones to increase capacity to 64 million tonnes a year from 52 million.
The work is scheduled for completion in May 1998.
The contract capped a healthy year for the company's order books, United said.
